meta.purpose: SupremeAI pre-production local knowledge injection seed. Evergreen, slow-changing, vendor-neutral knowledge used as primary context during external-provider outages (cold-start / degraded-mode resilience).
meta.usage: Embed each entry's `question` + `answer` (optionally `embedding_text`) into pgvector/ChromaDB. Serve via RAG as fallback when Tier-1..Tier-4 LLM providers are unreachable. Never inject secrets, prices, or real-time data.

embedding_guidance.chunk_strategy: one entry per vector; keep question+answer under ~400 tokens

volume_plan.rationale: Quality and coverage of evergreen concepts matter more than raw count. 1.5k curated entries covers core developer/AI/security surface; 6k reaches production-grade breadth.

categories.description: Timeless programming concepts: data structures, algorithms, complexity, design patterns, idioms.

entries.question: Big-O notation কি?
entries.answer: Big-O বড় ইনপুটের জন্য algorithm-এর time/space complexity-র উপরের সীমা দেখায়। O(1) constant, O(log n) logarithmic, O(n) linear, O(n log n), O(n^2) quadratic, O(2^n) exponential। Complexity বুঝে সঠিক data structure বাছাই করতে হয়।

entries.question: Array vs Linked List পার্থক্য?
entries.answer: Array contiguous memory; O(1) random access কিন্তু insert/delete O(n)। Linked List pointer-based; insert/delete head/tail O(1) কিন্তু access O(n)। Cache-friendly -> array; frequent insert/delete -> list/Deque।

entries.question: Hash table কিভাবে কাজ করে?
entries.answer: Key -> hash function -> bucket index। Average O(1) lookup/insert/delete। Collision chaining বা open addressing দিয়ে সামলানো হয়। Load factor বাড়লে resize (rehash) করতে হয়।

entries.question: Binary Search Tree (BST) কি?
entries.answer: Left child < node < right child property। Average O(log n) search/insert/delete; skewed tree-তে O(n)। Balanced variants: AVL, Red-Black, B-Tree (databases)।

entries.question: Stack vs Queue?
entries.answer: Stack LIFO (push/pop), function calls/undo-তে ব্যবহৃত। Queue FIFO (enqueue/dequeue), BFS/task scheduling-এ। Deque double-ended।

entries.question: Recursion vs Iteration?
entries.answer: Recursion function নিজেকে call করে base case-এ থামে; elegant কিন্তু stack overflow ঝুঁকি। Iteration loop দিয়ে; memory-efficient। Tail recursion কম্পাইলার optimize করতে পারে।

entries.question: Dynamic Programming (DP) কি?
entries.answer: Overlapping subproblems + optimal substructure থাকলে recursion-এর পুনরাবৃত্তি memoization (top-down) বা tabulation (bottom-up) দিয়ে কমাও। Example: Fibonacci, Knapsack, LCS, shortest path।

entries.question: SOLID principles কি?
entries.answer: S Single Responsibility, O Open/Closed (extend but not modify), L Liskov Substitution, I Interface Segregation, D Dependency Inversion। Maintainable OO design-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Singleton pattern কখন ব্যবহার করব?
entries.answer: App-জুড়ে exactly one instance দরকার (config, logger, connection pool)। Thread-safety নিশ্চিত করতে হয়। Dependency injection দিয়ে testability বাড়ান।

entries.question: Factory pattern কি?
entries.answer: Object creation logic ক্লায়েন্ট থেকে আড়াল করে subtype রিটার্ন করে। Tight coupling কমায়, new operator সরাসরি ব্যবহার এড়ায়।

entries.question: Observer pattern কি?
entries.answer: Subject state change-এ multiple observers-কে notify করে (pub/sub)। Event systems, reactive UIs। Memory leak এড়াতে unsubscribe জরুরি।

entries.question: Idempotency কি এবং কেন জরুরি?
entries.answer: একই request বারবার পাঠালেও একই effect (extra side-effect ছাড়া)। Retries/network failures-এ safe। API-তে idempotency key ব্যবহার কর।

entries.question: Pure function কি?
entries.answer: Same input -> same output, no side effects (no global mutation, no I/O)। Testing, caching (memoization), concurrency সহজ করে। Functional programming-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: NULL vs undefined পার্থক্য?
entries.answer: NULL ইচ্ছাকৃত empty/unknown মান; undefined অনুপস্থিত বা uninitialized। Language-ভেদে আলাদা (JS: undefined != null; SQL: NULL != anything incl. NULL)।

entries.question: Race condition কি?
entries.answer: Multiple threads/processes shared state একসাথে mutate করলে result execution order-এর ওপর নির্ভর করে। Locks, mutex, atomic ops, immutable data দিয়ে প্রতিরোধ।

entries.question: Deadlock কি এবং এড়ানোর উপায়?
entries.answer: Coffman conditions: mutual exclusion, hold & wait, no preemption, circular wait। Prevention: lock ordering, timeout, resource hierarchy। Detection + abort ও ব্যবহার হয়।

entries.question: Greedy vs Divide-and-Conquer vs Backtracking?
entries.answer: Greedy: local optimal সবসময় global optimal নাও হতে পারে (Huffman, Dijkstra)। Divide-Conquer: subproblem split (Merge Sort, Quick Sort)। Backtracking: constraint satisfaction (N-Queens, Sudoku)।

entries.question: Graph traversal: BFS vs DFS?
entries.answer: BFS queue-ভিত্তিক, shortest path (unweighted) ও level-order। DFS stack/recursion-ভিত্তিক, cycle detection, topological sort। Both O(V+E)।

entries.question: ACID vs BASE?
entries.answer: ACID (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) traditional SQL। BASE (Basically Available, Soft state, Eventual consistency) NoSQL/distributed। Trade-off: consistency vs availability (CAP)।

entries.question: Dijkstra vs Bellman-Ford?
entries.answer: Dijkstra: non-negative weights, O((V+E) log V) priority queue। Bellman-Ford: negative weights সাপোর্ট, negative cycle detect করে, O(VE)।

entries.question: Immutability কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ?
entries.answer: Data পরিবর্তন হয় না বলে concurrency bug, accidental mutation, caching কমে। Strings/collections immutable রাখো (final/const)। Copy-on-write যখন দরকার।

entries.question: What is a closure?
entries.answer: Function যা তার lexical scope-এর variables capture করে বাইরে থাকার পরেও। JS/Python callbacks, factories, private state-এ ব্যবহৃত। Memory leak ঝুঁকি থাকলে reference মুক্ত করো।

entries.question: Polymorphism কি?
entries.answer: একই interface বিভিন্ন behavior। Compile-time (overloading) এবং runtime (overriding, dynamic dispatch)। Liskov Substitution-এর সাথে SOLID-এর L।

entries.question: Normalization (1NF-3NF) কি?
entries.answer: 1NF atomic values; 2NF no partial dependency; 3NF no transitive dependency। Redundancy/anomaly কমায়। Performance-এর জন্য মাঝে মাঝে deliberate denormalization করা হয়।

categories.description: Timeless reliability, scalability, and distributed-systems design axioms.

entries.question: CAP theorem কি?
entries.answer: Distributed system-এ Consistency, Availability, Partition tolerance-এর মধ্যে একই সময়ে সব পাওয়া যায় না। Network partition অনিবার্য => C বা A-এর মধ্যে বেছে নিতে হয়।

entries.question: Circuit Breaker pattern কি?
entries.answer: Failure threshold ছাড়ালে downstream call বন্ধ (open) করে, অল্প বিরতিতে half-open probe পাঠায়। Cascading failure ও resource exhaustion ঠেকায়।

entries.question: Cache strategies: Cache-Aside vs Write-Through?
entries.answer: Cache-Aside: app নিজে cache populate (lazy)। Write-Through: write cache+db একসাথে। TTL + stale-while-revalidate + cache stampede prevention (lock/singleflight) জরুরি।

entries.question: Idempotency keys কেন দরকার?
entries.answer: Network retry-এ duplicate request আসতে পারে। Server idempotency key দিয়ে earlier result রি-রিটার্ন করে double-charge/duplicate-write ঠেকায়।

entries.question: Backpressure কি?
entries.answer: Consumer slow হলে producer-কে থামানো/স্লো করা যাতে queue overflow না হয়। Queue limits, rate limiting, reactive streams দিয়ে handle।

entries.question: Bulkhead pattern কি?
entries.answer: Resources পৃথক pool-এ ভাগ করো যাতে এক service-এর failure বাকিগুলোকে ডুবাতে না পারে (ship compartment)। Thread pools, connection pools per dependency।

entries.question: Eventual consistency vs Strong consistency?
entries.answer: Strong: read সবসময় latest write দেখে (CP systems)। Eventual: সময়ের সাথে converge (AP systems)। Use-case অনুযায়ী বাছাই (money=strong, feed=eventual)।

entries.question: Rate limiting algorithms?
entries.answer: Token Bucket (bursts allow), Leaky Bucket (smooth), Fixed/Sliding Window (simple)। User/IP/key dimension-এ apply; 429 + Retry-After return করো।

entries.question: Horizontal vs Vertical scaling?
entries.answer: Vertical = bigger machine (limited, downtime)। Horizontal = more nodes + load balancer (elastic, resilient)। Statelessness + shared store দিয়ে horizontal enable করো।

entries.question: Load balancer health checks কেন?
entries.answer: Unhealthy node থেকে traffic সরাতে periodic probe (HTTP/TCP)। Active/passive, sticky sessions, graceful drain জরুরি।

entries.question: CQRS pattern কি?
entries.answer: Command (write) ও Query (read) models আলাদা করো। Write-optimized + read-optimized store; scalability বাড়ায়। Eventual consistency-এর সাথে sync complexity বাড়ে।

entries.question: Saga pattern (distributed transactions)?
entries.answer: Long-running transaction-কে local txns + compensating actions-এ ভাগ করো। Failure-এ reverse steps চালাও। Choreography vs Orchestration।

entries.question: 12-factor app principles?
entries.answer: Codebase, dependencies, config (env), backing services, build/release/run, processes (stateless), port binding, concurrency, disposability, dev/prod parity, logs (stream), admin processes।

entries.question: Graceful degradation কি?
entries.answer: Partial failure-এ full outage-এর বদলে reduced functionality দাও (cache/stale data, feature flags)। User experience টিকিয়ে রাখে।

entries.question: Retry with exponential backoff + jitter?
entries.answer: Retry interval = base * 2^attempt + random jitter। Thunderin/retry storm ঠেকায়। Max retries + timeout + idempotency থাকা বাঞ্ছনীয়।

entries.question: Observability: logs, metrics, traces?
entries.answer: Logs (events), Metrics (counters/gauges/histograms), Traces (request path across services)। Three pillars মিলে root-cause analysis সম্ভব।

categories.description: Evergreen AI/ML theory that does not go stale with model releases.

entries.question: Supervised vs Unsupervised learning?
entries.answer: Supervised: labeled data (classification, regression)। Unsupervised: unlabeled (clustering, dimensionality reduction)। Semi-supervised/self-supervised মাঝামাঝি।

entries.question: Overfitting vs Underfitting?
entries.answer: Overfit: train low / val high error (model memorized)। Underfit: both high (too simple)। Trade-off via bias-variance। Regularization, more data, cross-validation সাহায্য করে।

entries.question: Train/Validation/Test split কেন?
entries.answer: Train model শেখায়, Validation hyperparam + early stopping, Test unseen generalization মাপে। Test কখনও training-এ ব্যবহার করা যাবে না (data leakage)।

entries.question: Cross-validation কি?
entries.answer: Data-কে k folds-এ ভাগ করে প্রতিবার আলাদা fold-কে test বানিয়ে average performance মাপে। k=5/10 common। Small datasets-এ জরুরি।

entries.question: Precision, Recall, F1 কি?
entries.answer: Precision = TP/(TP+FP), Recall = TP/(TP+FN), F1 = harmonic mean। Imbalanced data-এ accuracy ভুল বার্তা দেয়; PR-AUC/ROC-AUC দেখো।

entries.question: Confusion matrix কি?
entries.answer: TP, TN, FP, FN দেখায়। Derived: accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, FPR। Classification evaluation-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Regularization: L1 vs L2?
entries.answer: L2 (Ridge) weights shrink, smooth। L1 (Lasso) sparse, feature selection করে। Dropout, BatchNorm, Early Stopping ও overfitting কমায়।

entries.question: Gradient Descent variants?
entries.answer: Batch (full), Stochastic (1 sample), Mini-batch (common)। Optimizers: SGD, Momentum, RMSProp, Adam (adaptive lr)। Learning rate সবচেয়ে সংবেদনশীল hyperparam।

entries.question: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) কি?
entries.answer: LLM উত্তর দেওয়ার আগে external knowledge base থেকে relevant docs retrieve করে context-এ দেয়। Hallucination কমায়, source-grounded উত্তর দেয়।

entries.question: Embeddings কি?
entries.answer: Text/image-কে dense vector-এ map করে যাতে semantic similarity cosine distance দিয়ে মাপা যায়। Vector DB (pgvector, Chroma) retrieval-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Hallucination কি এবং কমানোর উপায়?
entries.answer: Model confident ভুল তথ্য বানায়। RAG, citation/grounding, constrained decoding, temperature নামানো, human-in-the-loop দিয়ে কমাও।

entries.question: Tokenization কি?
entries.answer: Text-কে tokens (subwords/words/chars) ভাগ করে model feed করা হয়। BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece common। Token count = cost + context limit metric।

entries.question: Temperature, Top-p, Top-k কি?
entries.answer: Temperature output randomness নিয়ন্ত্রণ (নিচে=deterministic)। Top-k/top-p nucleus sampling candidate tokens সীমিত করে। Creativity vs consistency trade-off।

entries.question: Transformer attention কিভাবে কাজ করে?
entries.answer: Query/Key/Value ম্যাট্রিক্স দিয়ে tokens-এর মধ্যে weighted relevance শেখে (scaled dot-product)। Parallelizable, long-range dependency catch করে। Encoder-Decoder/Decoder-only variants।

entries.question: Fine-tuning vs Prompt engineering vs RAG?
entries.answer: Prompt: zero-cost, fast, context-limited। RAG: external knowledge, grounded। Fine-tune: task-specific behavior, costly, needs data + drift maintenance।

entries.question: Bias in ML কেন হয়?
entries.answer: Biased training data, label noise, sampling skew, feedback loops। Mitigation: diverse data, fairness metrics, auditing, human review।

entries.question: Evaluation: BLEU/ROUGE vs human eval?
entries.answer: BLEU/ROUGE n-gram overlap (cheap, noisy)। Human eval quality/helpfulness মাপে (gold)। LLM-as-judge semi-automated proxy।

entries.question: Few-shot / Zero-shot learning?
entries.answer: Zero-shot: no example, prompt-এ task describe। Few-shot: prompt-এ কয়েকটি example (in-context learning)। Labeled training ছাড়াই generalize করে।

entries.question: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting?
entries.answer: Model-কে step-by-step ভাবতে বলো ('think step by step') -> complex reasoning উন্নত হয়। Intermediate steps verify করা সহজ।

entries.question: Vector similarity metrics?
entries.answer: Cosine (angle, normalized texts), Dot product (magnitude-aware), Euclidean (L2 distance)। Embeddings সাধারণত cosine। Normalization জরুরি।

categories.description: Timeless security axioms, OWASP, cryptography fundamentals.

entries.question: OWASP Top 10 (core classes)?
entries.answer: Injection, Broken Auth, Sensitive Data Exposure, XML External Entities, Broken Access Control, Security Misconfig, XSS, Insecure Deserialization, Components w/ known vulns, Insufficient logging।

entries.question: SQL Injection কি এবং প্রতিরোধ?
entries.answer: User input SQL query-তে concatenate করলে attacker query বদলায়। Parameterized queries / prepared statements, ORM, input validation, least-privilege DB user ব্যবহার করো।

entries.question: Hashing vs Encryption?
entries.answer: Hash one-way (passwords, integrity)। Encryption two-way reversible (confidentiality)। Password-এর জন্য bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2 (slow, salted)।

entries.question: Symmetric vs Asymmetric encryption?
entries.answer: Symmetric: এক key (AES) fast, key exchange সমস্যা। Asymmetric: public/private pair (RSA/ECC), slow, key exchange/signatures-এ। Hybrid (TLS) ব্যবহার হয়।

entries.question: HTTPS / TLS কি?
entries.answer: Transport encryption + server identity verification। Certificates (CA-signed) দিয়ে MITM ঠেকায়। HSTS, certificate rotation, strong ciphers জরুরি।

entries.question: Authentication vs Authorization?
entries.answer: AuthN: who you are (login, MFA)। AuthZ: what you can do (RBAC/ABAC permissions)। সবসময় আলাদা রাখো এবং প্রতিটি request-এ AuthZ check করো।

entries.question: Defense in depth কি?
entries.answer: একটি layer fail হলেও অন্য layer protect করে (firewall + WAF + auth + validation + monitoring)। Single control-এর ওপর নির্ভর করো না।

entries.question: Principle of least privilege?
entries.answer: User/service শুধু ততটুকু permission পাবে যতটুকু কাজের জন্য দরকার। Over-permission breach blast-radius বাড়ায়।

entries.question: XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) কি?
entries.answer: Attacker injected script victim browser-এ চলে। Prevention: output encoding, CSP, HttpOnly cookies, sanitize input। Stored/Reflected/DOM variants।

entries.question: CSRF কি এবং প্রতিরোধ?
entries.answer: Victim-এর authenticated session-এ attacker unwanted request পাঠায়। Prevention: CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies, origin checks।

entries.question: JWT (JSON Web Token) structure?
entries.answer: Header.payload.signature (base64url)। HS256 (shared secret) বা RS256 (asymmetric)। Secret leak বা `alg:none` attack এড়াতে algorithm pin করো।

entries.question: Salt and Pepper in password hashing?
entries.answer: Salt per-user random value (stored) prevents rainbow tables। Pepper global secret (not stored with hash) adds defense if DB leaks।

entries.question: Secrets management best practice?
entries.answer: Hardcode নয়; env vars / secret manager (Vault, Infisical) ব্যবহার। Rotate regularly, scope minimally, audit access, never commit to git।

entries.question: Rate limiting as security control?
entries.answer: Brute-force, credential stuffing, DoS কমায়। Per-IP/per-account limits + lockout + CAPTCHA + anomaly detection মিলিয়ে ব্যবহার করো।

entries.question: Zero Trust model কি?
entries.answer: Never trust, always verify। Network location-এর ওপর ভরসা নয়; every request authenticated, authorized, encrypted, continuous monitoring।

entries.question: Input validation vs Output encoding?
entries.answer: Input: allowlist, type/length/range checks (server-side)। Output: context-aware encoding (HTML/JS/SQL)। Don't trust any external data।

categories.description: SQL, modeling, ETL, and database timeless knowledge.

entries.question: Index কিভাবে কাজ করে?
entries.answer: B-Tree/B+Tree structure দিয়ে lookup O(log n)। SELECT fast কিন্তু INSERT/UPDATE slow (maintenance)। Over-indexing লাভ কমায়। Composite index-এ leftmost prefix rule মনে রাখো।

entries.question: JOIN types?
entries.answer: INNER (match both), LEFT/RIGHT/FULL OUTER, CROSS (cartesian), SELF। Join order + indexes query plan-এর জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

entries.question: Transaction isolation levels?
entries.answer: Read Uncommitted, Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable। Higher = fewer anomalies (dirty/non-repeatable/phantom reads) কিন্তু lower concurrency।

entries.question: Normalization vs Denormalization?
entries.answer: Normalize: write-heavy, consistency। Denormalize: read-heavy, analytics (warehouse)। Hybrid common (OLTP normalized, OLAP star schema)।

entries.question: Star vs Snowflake schema?
entries.answer: Star: central fact + denormalized dimensions (simple, fast)। Snowflake: normalized dimensions (less redundancy, more joins)। Warehousing-এ star standard।

entries.question: ETL vs ELT?
entries.answer: ETL: extract-transform-load (transform before warehouse)। ELT: load raw then transform (cloud warehouses-এর জন্য)। ELT modern standard (compute in warehouse)।

entries.question: Primary vs Foreign key?
entries.answer: PK uniquely identifies row (NOT NULL, unique)। FK references another table's PK, enforces referential integrity। Index FK for join performance।

entries.question: ACID properties explained?
entries.answer: Atomicity (all-or-nothing), Consistency (valid state), Isolation (concurrent safe), Durability (committed survives crash)। RDBMS guarantee।

entries.question: Pagination: OFFSET vs Keyset?
entries.answer: OFFSET নিয়ে large pages slow + unstable (inserts shift)। Keyset (WHERE id > last_id ORDER LIMIT) fast, stable। Infinite scroll-এ keyset prefer।

entries.question: NoSQL categories?
entries.answer: Document (MongoDB), Key-Value (Redis), Column (Cassandra), Graph (Neo4j)। Use-case অনুযায়ী বাছাই; schema flexibility vs strong consistency trade-off।

entries.question: Partitioning vs Sharding?
entries.answer: Partition: one DB-এর ভেতর logical split (manageability)। Shard: data multiple servers-এ (horizontal scale)। Both query routing + hotspot avoidance চায়।

entries.question: Data types: VARCHAR vs TEXT, INT vs BIGINT?
entries.answer: VARCHAR(N) bounded, TEXT unbounded। INT 2^31, BIGINT 2^63। Correct sizing storage + correctness বাঁচায়; overflow বাচাও।

categories.description: CI/CD, deployment, observability, incident response axioms.

entries.question: CI/CD কি?
entries.answer: Continuous Integration (frequent merge + automated tests) + Continuous Delivery/Deployment (automated release)। Fast feedback, smaller batches, lower risk।

entries.question: Blue-Green vs Canary deployment?
entries.answer: Blue-Green: two identical env, instant switch, easy rollback। Canary: gradual traffic shift (1%->100%), real-user validation, safer।

entries.question: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)?
entries.answer: Terraform/Pulumi দিয়ে infra declarative define করো। Version-controlled, reproducible, drift detection। Manual clicks avoid করো।

entries.question: Health checks vs Readiness vs Liveness?
entries.answer: Liveness: process alive? restart if not। Readiness: ready for traffic? (deps up)। Startup: boot complete? Kubernetes probes এই তিনটি আলাদা।

entries.question: Rollback vs Rollforward?
entries.answer: Rollback পূর্ববর্তী good version-এ ফেরত। Rollforward নতুন fix deploy করে এগিয়ে যায়। Automated rollback-এর জন্য health gates দরকার।

entries.question: SLI/SLO/SLA পার্থক্য?
entries.answer: SLI = measured indicator (latency, error rate)। SLO = target (99.9% uptime)। SLA = contractual penalty। Error budget ব্যবহার করে release pace নিয়ন্ত্রণ।

entries.question: Immutable infrastructure?
entries.answer: Servers never mutate; instead rebuild + replace। Config drift, snowflake servers এড়ায়। Containers/AMIs দিয়ে implement।

entries.question: Structured logging best practice?
entries.answer: JSON logs with consistent fields (timestamp, level, trace_id, service)। Human-readable নয়, machine-parseable + correlated by trace_id। Sensitive data redact করো।

entries.question: Chaos engineering কি?
entries.answer: Production-সদৃশ পরিবেশে ইচ্ছাকৃত failure (kill node, inject latency) ঘটিয়ে resilience পরীক্ষা করো। Hypothesis-driven, blast-radius limited।

entries.question: Feature flags কি?
entries.answer: Code deploy আর feature enable আলাদা করে। Dark launches, instant rollback, A/B tests। Flags-এর lifecycle (cleanup) manage করো।

categories.description: Timeless math and formal logic for reasoning and computation.

entries.question: Boolean algebra basic laws?
entries.answer: AND/OR/NOT। Commutative, Associative, Distributive, De Morgan (NOT(A AND B)=NOT A OR NOT B), Identity, Domination। Digital logic + query optimization-এ ব্যবহৃত।

entries.question: P vs NP সমস্যা?
entries.answer: P = polynomial-time solvable। NP = polynomial-time verifiable। P=NP? অমীমাংসিত। NP-complete (SAT, TSP) problems-এর জন্য heuristic/approx ব্যবহার করি।

entries.question: Modular arithmetic কি?
entries.answer: a mod n = remainder of a/n। Hashing, cryptography (RSA, Diffie-Hellman), checksums-এর ভিত্তি। Clock arithmetic analogy।

entries.question: Bayes' theorem কি?
entries.answer: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B)। Prior কে evidence দিয়ে update করে posterior। Spam filter, medical tests, probabilistic reasoning-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Prime numbers এবং GCD?
entries.answer: Prime: >1 with no divisors except 1 and self। Euclid's algorithm O(log min) GCD। RSA-তে large primes ব্যবহৃত।

entries.question: Logarithms কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ?
entries.answer: log_b(x) exponent such that b^that=x। Algorithmic complexity (binary search O(log n)), entropy, dB scales। Product->sum property (log(ab)=log a+log b)।

entries.question: Sets, unions, intersections?
entries.answer: Set theory foundation of databases/relational algebra। Union (OR), Intersection (AND), Difference, Cartesian product। SQL operators-এর সমতুল্য।

entries.question: Probability: independent vs conditional?
entries.answer: Independent: P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B)। Conditional: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B)। Gambler's fallacy এড়াও; base rate neglect common bias।

entries.question: Vector / dot product basics?
entries.answer: Vector magnitude + direction। Dot product = |a||b|cosθ = sum of element-wise products। Orthogonality (dot=0) ML embeddings-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Proof techniques?
entries.answer: Direct, Contrapositive, Contradiction, Induction (base + inductive step), Counterexample। Algorithm correctness ও math reasoning-এর ভিত্তি।

categories.description: General problem-solving, debugging, and decision methodologies.

entries.question: First-principles thinking কি?
entries.answer: Assumptions ভেঙে মৌলিক truths-এ নামো, তারপর নিচ থেকে logical rebuild করো। Analogy/status-quo-এর ওপর না ভরসা করে।

entries.question: Scientific method সমস্যা সমাধানে?
entries.answer: Observe -> hypothesize -> predict -> experiment -> analyze। Refutation দিয়ে theory শক্ত করো। A/B tests-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Rubber-duck debugging?
entries.answer: সমস্যা আভাসে/লিখে বা duck-এর কাছে বুঝিয়ে বলো -> gap নিজেই ধরা পড়ে। Articulate করলে cognition sharpen হয়।

entries.question: Divide and conquer (problem decomposition)?
entries.answer: বড় সমস্যাকে ছোট independent subproblems-এ ভাগ করো; আলাদা সমাধান then compose। MECE (Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive) চাও।

entries.question: Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys)?
entries.answer: Symptom থেকে 'why' 5 বার জিজ্ঞেস করে root cause পৌঁছাও। Surface symptom fix না করে systemic fix খোঁজে।

entries.question: Occam's Razor?
entries.answer: সমান ব্যাখ্যায় সবচেয়ে সরলটি prefer করো। Unnecessary complexity/assumptions এড়াও। Hypothesis pruning-এর নিয়ম।

entries.question: Cost-benefit / trade-off analysis?
entries.answer: Options-এর pros/cons, probability, impact মাপো। Opportunity cost মনে রাখো। Perfect-এর অপেক্ষায় না থেকে good-enough ship করো যখন reversible।

entries.question: Bias toward reversible vs irreversible decisions?
entries.answer: reversible = act fast, learn, adjust (Bezos 'type 2')। Irreversible = slow, deliberate, consult ('type 1')। Speed vs caution balance।

categories.description: Core physics/chemistry/biology laws that are evergreen.

entries.question: Newton-এর গতির সূত্র?
entries.answer: 1) Inertia (v=const unless force)। 2) F=ma। 3) Action=reaction। Classical mechanics-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Thermodynamics-এর মূল সূত্র?
entries.answer: 1st: energy conserved। 2nd: entropy বাড়ে (heat->work irreversible)। 3rd: absolute zero unreachable। Engines, refrigerators-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Conservation laws?
entries.answer: Energy, momentum, charge সংরক্ষিত। Closed system-এ মোট পরিমাণ অপরিবর্তিত। Physics/chemistry সব কিছুতে প্রযোজ্য।

entries.question: DNA structure ও function?
entries.answer: Double helix; A-T, C-G base pairing। Replication + protein coding (central dogma: DNA->RNA->protein)। Heredity-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Periodic table grouping?
entries.answer: Elements atomic number (protons) অনুযায়ী সাজানো। Groups (columns) similar valence/chemistry; periods (rows) shells। Noble gases inert।

entries.question: Electromagnetic spectrum?
entries.answer: Radio -> microwave -> infrared -> visible -> UV -> X-ray -> gamma। Wavelength কমলে energy বাড়ে (E=hf)। Communication + medical imaging-এ ব্যবহৃত।

entries.question: Cell theory?
entries.answer: All living things cells দিয়ে গঠিত; cell হলো basic unit; cells আগের cells থেকে তৈরি। Biology-এর ভিত্তি।

entries.question: Evolution by natural selection?
entries.answer: Variation + heredity + selection => advantageous traits accumulate। Species diversity-এর ব্যাখ্যা।

categories.description: Bangla-English technical glossary for bilingual grounding.

entries.question: 'Model is hallucinating' কে বাংলায়?
entries.answer: মডেল ভুল/কাল্পনিক তথ্য বানাচ্ছে (Model bhul/kalponik tothyo banacche)।

entries.question: 'Idempotent' কে বাংলায়?
entries.answer: অভেদ্য / পুনরাবৃত্তি-নিরপেক্ষ — বারবার চালালেও একই ফল (Idempotent = bar bar chalaleo eki fol)।

entries.question: 'Scalability' কে বাংলায়?
entries.answer: স্কেলযোগ্যতা / মাপযোগ্যতা — লোড বাড়লে সিস্টেম সুষ্ঠুভাবে বাড়ানো যায় (Scalability = load barle system barano jay)।

entries.question: 'Throughput' vs 'Latency'?
entries.answer: Throughput = কাজের হার (per second)। Latency = একটি কাজে সময় (delay)। অনেকসময় trade-off (buffer বাড়ালে latency↑ throughput↑)।

entries.question: 'Concurrency' vs 'Parallelism'?
entries.answer: Concurrency = অনেক কাজ একসাথে manage (interleaved)। Parallelism = অনেক কাজ একসাথে execute (multicore)।

entries.question: 'Refactor' কে বাংলায়?
entries.answer: পুনর্গঠন — behavior না বদলে কোডের গঠন উন্নত করা (Refactor = behavior na badle code structure improve)।

entries.question: 'Edge case' কে বাংলায়?
entries.answer: প্রান্তিক কেস / বিরল কিন্তু সম্ভাব্য পরিস্থিতি (Edge case = biral kintu possible situation)।

entries.question: 'Deterministic' vs 'Stochastic'?
entries.answer: Deterministic = নিশ্চিত ফল (same input same output)। Stochastic = এলোমেলো/সম্ভাব্যতা-নির্ভর (random)।

excluded_categories_reason.real_time_data: স্টক প্রাইস, আবহাওয়া, লাইভ নিউজ, crypto দাম — সেকেন্ডে stale হয়; static KB-তে inject নয়, live API fallback রাখো।
excluded_categories_reason.user_personal_data: ব্যক্তিগত/transactional/PII ডেটা কখনও static knowledge base-এ inject করা উচিত নয় (privacy + compliance)।
excluded_categories_reason.vendor_pricing: API দাম, quota, model names বারবার বদলায়; config/feature-flag-এ রাখো, evergreen KB-তে নয়।
excluded_categories_reason.current_events: নির্বাচন, sports scores, trending topics — ephemeral; RAG over live sources দিয়ে সাপোর্ট করো।
excluded_categories_reason.legal_regulatory: আইন/রেগুলেশন দেশ-ও-সময়-ভেদে বদলায়; disclaimer + human review রাখো।
